title: Jio Platforms Q2 Profit Rises 14% YoY To ₹8,387 Cr, Revenue Up 11%
summary: Jio Platforms Q2 Profit Rises 14% YoY To ₹8,387 Cr, Revenue Up 11%

sentences: Sequentially, net profit grew 8.0% from ₹7,764 Cr in Q1 FY27.
Operating revenue grew 11.4% YoY and 3.3% QoQ to ₹40,475 Cr in the quarter under review.
Jio Platforms’ other income jumped 49.5% YoY to ₹978 Cr.
Including this, total income increased to ₹41,453 Cr, up 12% from ₹36,986 Cr in Q2 FY26.
Total expenses increased 11.6% YoY to ₹30,194 Cr.
Network operating expenses, its largest expense head, increased 3.3% to ₹8,813 Cr.
The company incurred ₹2,872 Cr in tax expenses in Q2, comprising ₹30 Cr in current tax and ₹2,842 Cr in deferred tax.
With no exceptional items, its total comprehensive income for the quarter amounted to ₹8,509 Cr.
Its Q2 EBITDA grew 16.6% YoY to ₹21,879 Cr, a 4.9% sequential increase.
With capex excluded, its EBITDA was ₹15,449 Cr.
The company said its EBITDA growth was offset by higher finance costs due to 5G asset capitalisation in March 2026.
“This quarter’s results continue to reflect the strength of our 5G network, and the growing reach of our broadband and digital services,” said Jio’s MD Akash Ambani.
Shares of Jio ended today’s trading session 0.57% higher at ₹1,431.20 apiece on the BSE.
